name: code-craft
description: Clean Architecture feature implementation for any stack — mobile (Flutter, Android, iOS, React Native), web frontend, backend service, or desktop. Bundled mappings ship for the four mobile stacks and Node backends; every other stack is derived live from the project's own conventions, which are detected first and always win over the skill's defaults.

interface.longDescription: Implement, extend, or refactor a feature with Clean Architecture in whatever stack the project already uses — mobile, web frontend, backend service, or desktop. Code Craft enforces one dependency direction and nothing else: packages, naming, folder shape, state management, and error idiom are detected from the project and always win over the skill's defaults. It profiles the project, proposes the design before writing code, builds inside-out with a gate at each layer, then verifies against the project's own tests and dependency checks. Existing violations are reported, never copied and never silently rewritten; where the project's shape contradicts the layer contract, it stops and asks rather than deciding alone.
capabilities: Implement a feature with Clean Architecture
Refactor a feature onto clean layers
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature with Clean Architecture in this project's own conventions.
This screen calls the API directly — refactor it onto clean layers.
Propose the layer design for this feature before writing any code.
